# Agatha Sowerby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016)</sub>

## Appearance

She has been described as heavy and awkward in build.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019)_

## Personality

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby is a frank, opinionated, and outspoken woman who prides herself on stating her views without partiality or fear. She is highly observant of local affairs and neighbors, though she can be critical, judgmental, and lacking in imagination. Despite her sharp tongue and tendency to nag, she maintains deep sympathy for her friends in times of grief, offers practical help and guidance, and harbors good intentions.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P10](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0010), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)_

## Traits

- Outspoken and opinionated  <sub>[v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)</sub>
- Observant and inquisitive  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P10](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0010), [v1 c1 P15](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0015)</sub>
- Critical and fault-finding  <sub>[v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P24](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0024)</sub>
- Lacks imagination  <sub>[v1 c9 P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019)</sub>

## Abilities

- Experienced parent  <sub>[v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)</sub>
- Award-winning butter and cheese making
- Lace knitting and dressmaking

## Goals

- Monitor and give counsel on the moral upbringing and affairs of Brierley residents  <sub>[v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v1 c38 P14](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0014)</sub>

## History

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby walked up the road from Sowerby's Hollow to visit Thirza Abernethy at Grey Shutters after spotting Obed Abernethy departing unexpectedly with his horse and collar. Upon arriving, she inspected the set table and learned from Thirza that Obed had gone to Alder River Station to collect an orphan boy sent from Nova Scotia, a revelation that greatly surprised her. On a later occasion, Mrs. Agatha visited the Abernethy home and made blunt, critical remarks about Nell Harcourt's thin appearance, freckles, and red hair. Her comments provoked a fierce explosion of rage from Nell, who yelled, stamped her feet, and expressed absolute hatred for her before storming off to the east gable room. Appalled by Nell's temper, Mrs. Agatha scolded Thirza for her raising of the child and suggested using a birch rod, though Thirza stood up to her and accused her of being overly harsh. Deeply offended, Mrs. Agatha declared she would be careful with her words in the future and stormed off, warning Thirza of the grief the child would cause. Despite their friction, Mrs. Sowerby later reconciled with Nell after the girl offered a thorough apology.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P10](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0010), [v1 c1 P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014), [v1 c1 P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 c1 P17](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0017), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c9 P21](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0021), [v1 c9 P23](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0023), [v1 c9 P24](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0024), [v1 c9 P26](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0026), [v1 c9 P27](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0027), [v1 c9 P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v1 c38 P14](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0014)_

## Background by volume

- Raised ten children, two of whom died  <sub>[v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)</sub>
- Resides a quarter-mile up the road from Sowerby's Hollow near Grey Shutters
